omitted: endpoints, IPs, hostnames, usernames and paths
request messages, response content, reasoning, tool arguments and SSE events
raw error text, raw logs, model weights, images and archives
preserved: recorded transport/quality/usage states, including failure and in-flight
actual and expected token counts, output budget, latency and HTTP status
error existence/class/hash; raw detail remains local
source hashes and per-record source references
id_policy: request/case/source IDs are SHA-256-derived pseudonyms, not a claim of irreversible anonymization
raw_text_policy: Raw artifacts and private source map remain local; publish only this output directory
